requirement:
Operation intent:
Process a borrowing request from a user identifier and a book-copy barcode.

Preconditions:
- The User and BookCopy exist.
- The User has NORMAL borrowing status and no suspension days.
- A BACHELOR Student has fewer than 20 loans, a MASTER Student fewer than 40, another Student fewer than 60, and a Faculty user fewer than 60.
- The copy is AVAILABLE, or it is ONHOLDSHELF, marked reserved, and has a matching open reservation for this user.

Postconditions:
- A new unreturned Loan is created and linked to the User and BookCopy with today as the loan date.
- The due date is 30 days for a Student and 60 days for a Faculty user.
- The user loan count increases by one, the copy becomes LOANED, and the 3-, 10-, 17-, and 31-day overdue flags start as false.
- If the copy was ONHOLDSHELF, its reserved flag is cleared and the matching reservation is closed.
- The operation returns true.

reference.definition:
user:User = User.allInstances()->any(u:User | u.UserID = uid),
    stu:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(s:Student | s.UserID = uid),
    fac:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(f:Faculty | f.UserID = uid),
    copy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(bc:BookCopy | bc.Barcode = barcode),
    res:Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(r:Reserve | r.ReservedCopy = copy and r.ReservedUser = user and r.IsReserveClosed = false)
reference.precondition:
user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
    copy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
    user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
    user.SuspensionDays = 0 and
    if
      user.oclIsTypeOf(Student)
    then
      if
        stu.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR
      then
        stu.LoanedNumber < 20
      else
        if
          stu.Programme = Programme::MASTER
        then
          stu.LoanedNumber < 40
        else
          stu.LoanedNumber < 60
        endif
      endif
    else
      fac.LoanedNumber < 60
    endif and
    (copy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
      (copy.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and
        copy.IsReserved = true and
        res.oclIsUndefined() = false and
        res.IsReserveClosed = false
      )
    )
reference.postcondition:
let loan:Loan in
    loan.oclIsNew() and
    loan.LoanedUser = user and
    loan.LoanedCopy = copy and
    loan.IsReturned = false and
    loan.LoanDate = Today and
    user.LoanedNumber = user.LoanedNumber@pre + 1 and
    user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and
    copy.LoanedRecord->includes(loan) and
    if
      user.oclIsTypeOf(Student)
    then
      loan.DueDate = Today.After(30)
    else
      loan.DueDate = Today.After(60)
    endif and
    if
      copy.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF
    then
      copy.IsReserved = false and
      res.IsReserveClosed = true
    endif and
    copy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
    loan.OverDue3Days = false and
    loan.OverDue10Days = false and
    loan.OverDue17Days = false and
    loan.OverDue31Days = false and
    Loan.allInstances()->includes(loan) and
    result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Renew an active loan for a user and a loaned book copy.

Preconditions:
- The User, BookCopy, and matching Loan exist and the User has NORMAL status.
- The copy is not reserved, the due date is after today, and the Loan has no overdue fee.
- A Student has fewer than 3 renewals and a Faculty user has fewer than 6.

Postconditions:
- The renewal count increases and the renewal date becomes today.
- From its previous value, the due date is extended by 20 days for a BACHELOR Student, 40 for a MASTER Student, 60 for another Student, and 60 for Faculty.
- The operation returns true.

reference.definition:
user:User = User.allInstances()->any(u:User | u.UserID = uid),
			stu:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(s:Student | s.UserID = uid),
			fac:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(f:Faculty | f.UserID = uid),
			copy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(bc:BookCopy | bc.Barcode = barcode and bc.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED),
			loan:Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(l:Loan | l.LoanedUser = user and l.LoanedCopy = copy and l.IsReturned = false)
reference.precondition:
user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
			user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
			copy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
			loan.oclIsUndefined() = false and
			copy.IsReserved = false and
			loan.DueDate.isAfter(Today) and
			if
				user.oclIsTypeOf(Student)
			then
				loan.RenewedTimes < 3
			else
				loan.RenewedTimes < 6
			endif and
			loan.OverDueFee = 0
reference.postcondition:
loan.RenewedTimes = loan.RenewedTimes@pre + 1 and
			loan.RenewDate = Today and
			if
				user.oclIsTypeOf(Student)
			then
				if
					stu.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR
				then
					loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(20)
				else
					if
						stu.Programme = Programme::MASTER
					then
						loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(40)
					else
						loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60)
					endif
				endif
			else
				loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60)
			endif and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Pay the current sale with the supplied cash amount.

Preconditions:
- The current Sale exists, is incomplete, and is ready for payment.
- The tendered amount covers the Sale amount.

Postconditions:
- A CashPayment records the tendered amount and change and is linked to the Sale.
- The Sale is linked to the current Store, timestamped, and marked complete.
- The payment is stored and the operation returns true.

reference.precondition:
CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
amount >= CurrentSale.Amount
reference.postcondition:
let cp:CashPayment in
cp.oclIsNew() and
cp.AmountTendered = amount and
cp.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = cp and
CurrentSale.Belongedstore = CurrentStore and
CurrentStore.Sales->includes(CurrentSale) and
CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
CurrentSale.Time = Now and
cp.Balance = amount - CurrentSale.Amount and
CashPayment.allInstances()->includes(cp) and
result = true

Preconditions:

- The scanned Item exists and has positive stock.

Postconditions:

- The Item stock decreases by the entered quantity.
- The operation returns true.

reference.precondition:
CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
item.StockNumber > 0
reference.postcondition:

sli.oclIsNew() and
self.CurrentSaleLine = sli and
sli.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(sli) and
sli.Quantity = quantity and
sli.BelongedItem = item and
item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber@pre - quantity and
sli.Subamount = item.Price * quantity and
SalesLineItem.allInstances()->includes(sli) and
result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Record a staff approval decision for a repair request.

Preconditions:
- The referenced Repair exists.
- The referenced Staff member exists.

Postconditions:
- A new ApprovalHistory records the decision and suggestion and is linked to the Repair.
- When reject is true, Process advances from 0 to 1 for a role-1 Staff member, from 1 to 2 for role 2, and from 2 to 3 for role 3.
- When reject is false, Repair.Process is set to the rejected stage value 5.
- The operation returns the new ApprovalHistory.

reference.definition:
rep:Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(u:Repair | u.Id = rid),
                 sta:Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(uu:Staff | uu.Id = sid)
reference.postcondition:
let ah:ApprovalHistory in
			ah.oclIsNew() and
			ah.Reject = reject and
			ah.Suggestion = suggestion and
			ApprovalHistory.allInstances()->includes(ah) and
			rep.History->includes(ah) and
			if
				reject <> false
			then
				if
					rep.Process = 0 and // STAFFREQUEST
					sta.Role = 1 // MASTER
				then
					rep.Process = 1 // MASTERAPPROVE
				else
					if
						rep.Process = 1 and // MASTERAPPROVE
						sta.Role = 2 // MANAGER
					then
						rep.Process = 2 // MANAGERAPPROVE
					else
						if
							rep.Process = 2 and // MANAGERAPPROVE
							sta.Role = 3 // WORKER
						then
							rep.Process = 3 // WORKERAPPROVE
						endif
					endif
				endif
			else
				rep.Process = 5 // REJECT
			endif and
			Repair.allInstances()->includes(rep) and
			result = ah

- The supplied author name is not empty.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns Books whose author equals the supplied name.

reference.postcondition: result = Book.allInstances()->select(book:Book | book.Author = authorname)

requirement:
Operation intent:
Search the library catalog by ISBN.

Preconditions:
- The supplied ISBN is a String value.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns Books whose ISBN equals the supplied value.

reference.postcondition: result = Book.allInstances()->select(book:Book | book.ISBn = iSBNnumber)

requirement:
Operation intent:
Search the library catalog by subject.

Preconditions:
- The supplied subject is a String value.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns Books linked to a Subject with the supplied name.

reference.postcondition: result = Book.allInstances()->select(book:Book | book.Subject->exists(s:Subject | s.Name = subject))

requirement:
Operation intent:
Send a notification to a supplied email address.

Preconditions:
- The email address is not empty.

Postconditions:
- The notification request succeeds and the operation returns true.

reference.postcondition: result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Close an existing open loan.

Preconditions:
- The Loan exists and has LSOPEN status.

Postconditions:
- The Loan status becomes CLOSED.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
loan.Status = LoanStatus::CLOSED and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Select one loan request from the current request collection.

Preconditions:
- The supplied request identifier matches a current LoanRequest.

Postconditions:
- The matching request becomes the current LoanRequest and is returned.

reference.postcondition: self.CurrentLoanRequest = rs and result = rs

requirement:
Operation intent:
Mark the selected loan request references as validated.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest exists.

Postconditions:
- Its status becomes REFERENCESVALIDATED.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
self.CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::REFERENCESVALIDATED and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Select a loan request from the current collection for review.

Preconditions:
- The supplied identifier matches a current LoanRequest.

Postconditions:
- The matching request becomes the current LoanRequest and is returned.

reference.postcondition: self.CurrentLoanRequest = rs and result = rs

requirement:
Operation intent:
Retrieve the credit history attached to the current loan request.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest and its requested CreditHistory exist.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns that CreditHistory.

reference.postcondition: result = CurrentLoanRequest.RequestedCreditHistory

requirement:
Operation intent:
Retrieve the checking-account history attached to the current loan request.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest and its requested CheckingAccount exist.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns that CheckingAccount.

reference.postcondition: result = CurrentLoanRequest.RequestedCAHistory

requirement:
Operation intent:
List all loan terms available for evaluation.

Preconditions:
- No additional business condition is required.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns all LoanTerm records.

reference.postcondition: result = LoanTerm.allInstances()

requirement:
Operation intent:
Attach a selected loan term to the current loan request.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest exists.
- The selected LoanTerm exists.

Postconditions:
- The LoanTerm is linked to the current request.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(loanterm) and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Approve the current loan request.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest exists.

Postconditions:
- Its status becomes APPROVED.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
self.CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::APPROVED and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Create a loan account with the supplied identifier, balance, and status.

Preconditions:
- The loan-account identifier is unused.

Postconditions:
- A new LoanAccount stores the supplied values and enters the repository.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
let loa:LoanAccount in
			loa.oclIsNew() and
			loa.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and
			loa.Balance = balance and
			loa.Status = status and
			LoanAccount.allInstances()->includes(loa) and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Create a LoanTerm record from the supplied item identifier, content.

Preconditions:
- No existing LoanTerm has the supplied item identifier.

Postconditions:
- A new LoanTerm is stored with the supplied item identifier, content.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
let loa:LoanTerm in
			loa.oclIsNew() and
			loa.ItemID = itemid and
			loa.Content = content and
			LoanTerm.allInstances()->includes(loa) and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Retrieve the LoanTerm identified by the supplied item identifier.

Preconditions:
- The referenced LoanTerm exists.

Postconditions:
- The operation returns the referenced LoanTerm.

reference.postcondition: result = loanterm

requirement:
Operation intent:
Update the LoanTerm identified by item identifier with the supplied item identifier, content.

Preconditions:
- The referenced LoanTerm exists.

Postconditions:
- The stored LoanTerm contains the supplied item identifier, content.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
loanterm.ItemID = itemid and
			loanterm.Content = content and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Delete the LoanTerm identified by the supplied item identifier.

Preconditions:
- The referenced LoanTerm exists in the repository.

Postconditions:
- The LoanTerm is removed from the repository.
- The operation returns true.

reference.postcondition:
LoanTerm.allInstances()->excludes(loanterm) and
			result = true

requirement:
Operation intent:
Calculate and record the credit score for the current loan request.

Preconditions:
- A current LoanRequest, its checking-account history, and its credit history exist.

Postconditions:
- The request credit score becomes 100 and its status becomes SUBMITTED.
- The operation returns the calculated score.

reference.precondition:
self.CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
			CurrentLoanRequest.RequestedCAHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false and
			CurrentLoanRequest.RequestedCreditHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false
reference.postcondition:
self.CurrentLoanRequest.CreditScore = 100 and
			self.CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
			result = self.CurrentLoanRequest.CreditScore
